title: SABL moves to Robinhood Chain: a blueprint for a migration that keeps every holder and every promise
summary: On 12 September the Sable team announced that SABL moves to Robinhood Chain, details to follow. A community blueprint for the mechanism: why a one-way burn-and-mint with no deadline fits this token better than a snapshot or a two-way bridge, ten steps that carry the whitepaper's fixed-supply promise across, the traps to skip, and what the Observatory offers to help. Opinion, with a dated fact base.

title: Should Sable bridge to Robinhood Chain? What the poll is really asking
summary: A community poll asks whether Sable should bridge to Robinhood Chain. The question bundles two decisions with different costs, moving the SABL token and adding the chain as a payment rail. The pros, the cons, and where the author lands.
